name: Aoyagi Shion
source:
Shion was the only member of the Kunahama FC until Masaya and Asuka joined, thus making him the current president. A very lively and affectionate fellow that always emphasizes his muscles more than anything else.

[Taken from [url=https://aokanatranslation.wordpress.com/game-info/side-characters/]AoKana Translation Page[/url]]
